name: Tick Buffer Auto-Correct
description: Buffers early clicks by 1-16 ticks on 240 TPS until a tick that passes the click and survives the next 480 ticks.

enabled.name: Enable Auto Tick Buffer
enabled.description: Automatically buffers early clicks by 1 to N ticks until a tick that passes the click and survives the next 480 ticks on 240 TPS.

max-early-ticks.name: Early Click Window (Ticks)
max-early-ticks.description: Maximum number of ticks (1-16) at 240 TPS to delay/buffer an early click to find a surviving trajectory.

lookahead-ticks.name: Survival Check Lookahead (Ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: Number of future 240 TPS ticks to simulate to verify the click does not die (default: 480 ticks = 2.0 seconds at 240 TPS).

min-hold-ticks.name: Minimum Buffered Hold (Ticks)
min-hold-ticks.description: If you release your tap before the buffered click fires, hold the injected click for at least this many 240Hz ticks.

show-hud.name: Show Live Buffer HUD
show-hud.description: Displays a small status label in PlayLayer showing current 1-16 tick window and how many ticks the last click was buffered.

dual-player.name: Apply to Player 2 (Dual Mode)
dual-player.description: Also auto-buffers early clicks for the secondary player in Dual / 2-Player levels.
